description: Use before connecting a remote MCP server: independent checks by registry name or URL. Uptime and connect time from daily probes (initialize and tools/list; no tool is ever called), sign-in mode, protocol version, tool count, and tool-definition changes in 30 days (how 'rug pull' attacks work), with domain age, a grade and reasons. Covers remote servers in the Official MCP Registry. Signed. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).
